title: WP_REST_API_Entity_Actions
description: The actions registered for an entity type in a REST API context.

actions.description: The actions registered for the entity, in registration order.

items.description: The serializable part of an action. Plugins can register actions with additional properties.

id.description: The unique identifier of the action.

origin.description: Who registered the action: `core`, or the slug of a plugin or theme.

isPrimary.description: Whether the action is a primary action.

supportsBulk.description: Whether the action can be performed on several items at once.

context.description: The context the action is limited to, such as `list` for the lists of items. Without it, the action shows everywhere.

modalHeader.description: The header of the modal of the action.

hideModalHeader.description: Whether to hide the header of the modal of the action.

modalSize.description: The size of the modal of the action.

modalFocusOnMount.description: Where the focus goes when the modal of the action opens.

script_modules.description: The script modules providing the JavaScript parts of the actions, each with the ids of the actions it applies to.

id.description: The id of the script module.

actions.description: The ids of the actions the script module applies to.
